sources.source: Social Work England annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The audited report was published on 10 July 2026 and covers Social Work England activities, achievements and expenditure from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds professional-regulation context while retaining registrant-versus-person, fitness-to-practise, activity-versus-safeguarding-outcome and England-only guards.

sources.source: Student loans in England: 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The accredited release was published on 18 June 2026 and updated on 2 July 2026 with a correction to a future-cohort calculation; it covers loan outlays, repayments, balances and borrower activity through 2025-26.
sources.quality_effect: Adds correction-aware finance context while retaining borrower-versus-account, stock-versus-flow, plan, repayment-status, domicile and revision guards.

sources.source: SLC Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Annual Report 2025-26
sources.verified_fact: Published on 30 March 2026, the report reviews Student Loans Company progress against equality objectives in its 2023-2026 EDI strategy.
sources.quality_effect: Adds institutional equality-governance context while retaining objective-versus-outcome, employee-versus-customer, reporting-period and no-local-harm inference guards.

sources.source: Independent Assessors’ Annual Report 2024/25
sources.verified_fact: The report was published on 18 September 2025 and updated on 19 September with the Student Loans Company response; it summarises appeals and complaints reviewed during the prior 12 months.
sources.quality_effect: Adds complaint-review context while retaining appeal-versus-customer, recommendation-versus-implementation, complaint selection and reporting-lag guards.

sources.source: DfT: annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 15 July 2026, the report accounts for Department for Transport resource use, activities, strategy, outcomes and governance from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 and includes supporting datasets.
sources.quality_effect: Adds cross-transport governance context while retaining departmental-versus-operator, expenditure-versus-outcome, mode, reporting-year and no-direct-casualty substitution guards.

sources.source: DFTO: annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 15 July 2026, the report covers DFTO strategy, directors, governance, independent audit and consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds publicly owned rail-operator governance context while retaining company-versus-service, operator-versus-network, finance-versus-reliability and corporate-output guards.

sources.source: HS2 Ltd annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 10 July 2026, the report reviews HS2 Ltd activities, project highlights and progress against organisational objectives for the period ending 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds major-project governance context while retaining milestone-versus-completion, project-versus-site, construction activity, cost and safety-outcome guards.

sources.source: Traffic Commissioners: annual report 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: Published on 7 August 2025, the report covers major aspects of Traffic Commissioners’ judicial, regulatory and administrative roles during 2024-25 and includes accessible statistics.
sources.quality_effect: Adds commercial-vehicle and public-service-vehicle oversight context while retaining licence-versus-operator, hearing, sanction, vehicle and road-safety-outcome guards.

sources.source: VCA: annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: Published on 16 January 2026, the report documents Vehicle Certification Agency activity and expenditure for the 2024-25 period.
sources.quality_effect: Adds automotive type-approval governance context while retaining approval-versus-vehicle, test-versus-market surveillance, expenditure and no-defect-prevalence inference guards.

sources.source: Annual rail consumer report 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The latest report was published on 9 July 2026 and covers ticket retailing, passenger rights, information, accessible travel, complaints, compensation and the Rail Ombudsman from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds passenger-protection context while retaining complaint-versus-journey, operator, compensation, accessibility and consumer-outcome-versus-safety guards.

sources.source: Annual assessment of Network Rail 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The assessment reviews Network Rail performance from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, the second year of control period 7, with explicit attention to constrained funding and ageing assets.
sources.quality_effect: Adds infrastructure-performance context while retaining control-period, region, asset, funding-versus-condition and performance-versus-incident guards.

sources.source: Office for Students: annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: Published and laid before Parliament on 17 July 2025, the report covers Office for Students activities and achievements from April 2024 to March 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds higher-education regulation context while retaining provider-versus-student, registration, intervention, academic-year and no-student-safety incidence guards.

sources.source: Regulator of Social Housing - Annual Report and Accounts 2024-25
sources.verified_fact: Published on 4 December 2025, the report sets out the regulator’s objectives, activities, risks, performance, governance and financial statements for 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds social-housing oversight context while retaining provider-versus-home, regulatory judgement, tenant outcome, reporting-lag and no-building-level risk guards.

sources.source: Gambling Commission annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: Published on 29 July 2025 and updated on 7 January 2026 with a Trust Statement, the report covers Gambling Commission activity and accounts from 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds regulated-gambling governance context while retaining licence-versus-operator, enforcement, consumer participation, detected-harm and reporting-period guards.

sources.source: Ofcom annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: Published and laid before Parliament on 10 July 2025, the report covers Ofcom regulation of broadcasting, telecoms, postal services and spectrum for 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds communications-sector governance context while retaining service-versus-user, complaint, enforcement, online-safety duty and no-harm-prevalence substitution guards.

sources.source: FCA Annual Report and Accounts 2025/26
sources.verified_fact: First published on 9 July 2026 and updated on 15 July, the report covers the first year of the FCA’s five-year strategy and reports an estimated £5.6 billion of benefits to consumers, firms and the wider economy.
sources.quality_effect: Adds financial-conduct regulation context while retaining estimated-versus-realised benefit, case-versus-firm, enforcement, consumer-loss and model-assumption guards.

sources.source: Bank of England Annual Report and Accounts 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 25 June 2026, the report covers 1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026 and includes policy committees, organisational, financial, risk-management and governance reporting.
sources.quality_effect: Adds central-bank governance context while retaining policy-function-versus-market-outcome, reporting-year, committee, balance-sheet and no-local-risk inference guards.

sources.source: Prudential Regulation Authority Annual Report 2025/26
sources.verified_fact: Published on 25 June 2026, the report covers 1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026 and the PRA’s work on banking and insurance safety, soundness, resilience, competition and growth objectives.
sources.quality_effect: Adds prudential-resilience context while retaining regulated-firm-versus-sector, stress-test-versus-forecast, authorisation, capital and no-firm-failure probability guards.

sources.source: FMI Annual Report 2025-26
sources.verified_fact: Published on 25 June 2026, the report covers Bank supervision of central counterparties, central securities depositories and recognised payment systems from 26 June 2025 to 28 February 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds critical-financial-infrastructure context while retaining transaction-value-versus-risk, supervised-firm, availability, incident, period and no-local-exposure guards.

sources.source: National Security and Investment Act 2021: Annual Report 2025-26
sources.verified_fact: Published on 14 July 2026, the report describes operation of the National Security and Investment system from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds investment-screening context while retaining notification-versus-acquisition, call-in, review, final order, sector and no-threat-prevalence inference guards.

sources.source: UK Debt Management Office and Debt Management Account annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 15 July 2026, the report presents the annual accounts of the UK Debt Management Office and Debt Management Account and was laid before Parliament.
sources.quality_effect: Adds sovereign-financing operational context while retaining issuance-versus-stock, cash management, market operation, account and no-financial-distress inference guards.

sources.source: PWLB annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Public Works Loan Board and UK Debt Management Office
sources.verified_fact: Published on 2 July 2026, the annual report and accounts was laid before Parliament in response to a legislative requirement.
sources.quality_effect: Adds public-sector lending context while retaining loan-versus-authority, balance-versus-flow, purpose, repayment and no-local-service-risk inference guards.

sources.source: National Insurance Fund Investment Account Report and Accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: HM Treasury and UK Debt Management Office
sources.verified_fact: Published on 15 July 2026, the report presents the annual accounts of the National Insurance Fund Investment Account and was ordered to be printed by the House of Commons.
sources.quality_effect: Adds social-security investment-account context while retaining fund-versus-beneficiary, investment balance, cash flow and no-household-risk inference guards.

sources.source: The Crown Estate annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 26 June 2026 for the year ended 31 March 2026, the organisation’s thirteenth integrated report covers performance, business model, strategy and value creation.
sources.quality_effect: Adds public-estate governance context while retaining asset-versus-property, portfolio-versus-place, value, strategy and no-local-environmental-or-safety outcome guards.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Corporate and regulatory annual reports describe activity, governance, finance and institutional performance rather than local harm prevalence.
Student-loan borrowers, accounts, balances, outlays and repayments are different units; the 2026 correction is retained.
Transport departments, operators, projects, licensing bodies and certification agencies use different operational units and outcomes.
Rail consumer complaints, infrastructure assessments and safety incidents are not interchangeable.
Social-work, higher-education, social-housing, gambling and communications regulation cannot be downscaled to parcel-level risk.
Financial-regulation estimated benefits, stress tests, transaction values and supervisory activity do not directly measure realised consumer loss or firm failure.
National-security investment notifications, reviews and final orders are distinct stages and do not establish threat prevalence.
Debt, lending, investment-account and public-estate reporting provides governance context rather than household or local safety outcomes.
The uploaded 046 note remains non-canonical without matching task, heartbeat, claim and receipt evidence.
No existing candidate score, endpoint manifest or stored parcel value was modified.
